import json,random,sys,subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/.deps')
import fuzz, verify as V
from protocol import validate
seed=int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 1
target=int(sys.argv[1])
rnd=random.Random(seed)
for trial in range(target+1):
    ncases=rnd.randint(0,3)
    request={'cases':[fuzz.rand_case(rnd) for _ in range(ncases)]}
    validate(json.loads(json.dumps(request)))
    proc=fuzz.run_child(request)
    from protocol import loads
    resp=loads(proc.stdout)
    try:
        V.verify(request,resp,validate)
    except V.Bad as exc:
        print('trial',trial,exc)
        json.dump(request,open('/workspace/failures/one.json','w'))
        json.dump(resp,open('/workspace/failures/one_resp.json','w'))
        break
PYEOF
source dev.sh && python3 dbg1.py 26 1 2>&1 | tail -3
